The Owner's visible Projects Master establishes the following project context:
the secretary should not need to open server folders, invoices, receipts and cheques one by one to determine a project's financial position.
The Project Master should calculate it from governed financial events.
The video visibly shows milestone blocks with approximately:
Milestone → Date → Amount → Invoice → Receipt IDs → Actual Collected
That is now a frozen requirement.
What remains is the Owner-facing financial projection:
Two distinct billing modes are mandatory.
🔴 exact recurring supervision scheduling/work-queue semantics.
I would also add a structured service period—for example 2026-08 SUPERVISION—instead of hiding the period only in free-text description.
The Owner's actual method is essentially:
find the previous invoice for the same project → Save As/clone → change global reference, dates and service period → preserve unchanged customer/project/bank details → save as the new invoice.
That exact productivity flow still matters even though the future system does not need to mimic Word/File Explorer literally.
1. Company/global invoice reference
2. Project-local invoice sequence
previous project invoice 03 → new project invoice 04.
🔴 I have not proven an explicit project-local sequential invoice ordinal with the Owner's required invariant.

A generic InvoiceReference could technically hold such a value, but I would not sign that requirement off until the project-local sequence is explicit, uniqueness/scoping is tested, and migration from existing folders is proven.
invoice prepared → human review → printed → manager signature/stamp → delivered to client → client signs/acknowledges receipt → returned scan/photo becomes evidence.
delivery, acknowledgment, approval and payment remain separate evidence-backed events.
This is an area where the architecture already aligns strongly with the Owner.
Invoice Report / complete history
Invoice Reference · Invoice Date · Due Date · Project · Invoice Amount · Paid/Collected · Outstanding · Status · Description/Service Period
The video separately shows an Open Invoice sheet with operational columns such as:
Invoice Reference No. · Projects · Invoice Issue Date · Amount · Description · NOTE · expected
Again: 🟡 strong foundation, but the Owner-specific open-receivable operating surface still needs convergence.
Payment Evidence ≠ Verified Receipt ≠ Payment Allocation ≠ Invoice Fully Paid ≠ Project Fully Settled
cheque / receipt voucher / bank transfer.
It also requires partial and full collection to affect invoice/project numbers.
record evidence → verify receipt → allocate → recompute invoice outstanding → close when zero → update milestone actual collected → update Project Total Receipts → update Project Balance.
That full projection needs explicit acceptance tests against Owner examples.
Total Receipts = 10,000 Balance = 10,000
Total Receipts = 20,000 Balance = 0
Project Total Receipts = Σ valid payment allocations attributable to that project
Project Balance = authoritative project/contract value – Total Receipts
Not from an operator manually entering 10,000 or 0.

For multi-currency projects, the sheet's separate Contract Currency / Contract Value / QAR Amount means we need explicit conversion/provenance semantics before implementing the QAR projection. I would not invent that rule from this video.
PROPOSAL CONTRACT INVOICES RECEIVED INVOICES CHEQUE / RECEIPT VOUCHER / BANK TRANSFER PAYMENT REPORT
invoice artifact → issued copy → client acknowledgment → payment evidence → payment history/report, all linked to the same project/invoice lineage.
But I am not interpreting that as automatic Owner approval for a fourth global persona.

There must be an authorized operational capability/work queue for the finance/secretary function to prepare invoices, update permitted receivable information, record returned acknowledgment/payment evidence and perform explicitly allowed actions.
How that maps to the protected visible-persona model requires an explicit product decision.
Engineering/PM also needs a controlled way to trigger/request a billable design milestone, without thereby acquiring invoice issue/payment authority.

Projects Master Invoice Report Open Invoice existing invoices received/signed invoices cheque/receipt-voucher/bank-transfer evidence payment reports project folders existing global invoice references existing project-local invoice sequence historical collections.
This remains a 🔴 material gap until real AMEC financial data is imported, reconciled and accepted.
The app must not start a new numbering universe that collides with historical invoices.
